1.w: By David. Praise the Lord, O my soul. With all that is within me, praise his holy name.

2.w: Praise the Lord, O my soul. Do not forget all his kind deeds.

3.w: He is the one who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

4.w: who delivers your life from the Pit, who crowns you with his loyal love and compassion,

5.w: who satisfies your life with good things, so your youth is renewed like an eagle’s.

6.w: The Lord does what is fair, and executes justice for all the oppressed.

7.w: The Lord revealed his faithful acts to Moses, his deeds to the Israelites.

8.w: The Lord is compassionate and merciful; he is patient and demonstrates great loyal love.

9.w: He does not always accuse and does not stay angry.

10.w: He does not deal with us as our sins deserve; he does not repay us as our misdeeds deserve.

11.w: For as the skies are high above the earth, so his loyal love towers over his faithful followers.

12.w: As far as the eastern horizon is from the west, so he removes the guilt of our rebellious actions from us.

13.w: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on his faithful followers.

14.w: For he knows what we are made of; he realizes we are made of clay.

15.w: A person’s life is like grass. Like a flower in the field it flourishes,

16.w: but when the hot wind blows, it disappears, and one can no longer even spot the place where it once grew.

17.w: But the Lord continually shows loyal love to his faithful followers and is faithful to their descendants,

18.w: to those who keep his covenant, who are careful to obey his commands.

19.w: The Lord has established his throne in heaven; his kingdom extends over everything.

20.w: Praise the Lord, you angels of his, you powerful warriors who carry out his decrees and obey his orders.

21.w: Praise the Lord, all you warriors of his, you servants of his who carry out his desires.

22.w: Praise the Lord, all that he has made, in all the regions of his kingdom. Praise the Lord, O my soul.
